recommended_language: Most source records are DRECP ecoregion subarea allocations within the California Desert National Conservation Lands program, not independently established monuments or national conservation areas.
BLM planning and management authority applies to BLM-administered public lands and applicable BLM interests; the broad mapped polygon is not proof that every acre is BLM-owned.
The GIS boundary is a screening and reference geometry, not a legal survey, cadastral determination, or controlling designation map.
An overlapping or similarly named monument, wilderness, WSA, ACEC, trail, river, or other designation retains its own authority, boundary, management, and BRIM layer identity.
Mapped area is geometry-calculated from the source Shape__Area in EPSG:3310. It is not legal or official acreage unless a separate official reported value and source are shown.
DRECP-reported subarea acreages are rounded BLM-administered allocation figures and are not directly interchangeable with broad source-polygon geometry area.
A field office shown from a spatial intersection is contextual only unless a separate authoritative source directly documents responsibility.
Access, route designation, closures, permits, fire restrictions, and land-status conditions change. Verify current information with the responsible land manager before travel or use.

The source layer uses “Desert Lily Preserve.” Official sources also identify a Desert Lily Preserve ACEC and a statutory Desert Lily Sanctuary. Do not assume the three records are identical or coterminous without boundary verification.
